description: Often copied but never equaled, the Bosch 1618EVS revolutionized the mid-size D-Handle fixed-base router category: designed for a broad range of routing applications, the versatile Bosch 1618EVS was the first router in its category to have a 2.25 (Max.) horsepower rating, linear depth adjustment and numerous other Bosch routing innovations.
